description: # Lie Groups and Lie Algebras (2023). | **Mailing Address:** | Associate Professor Department of Mathematics Indian Institute of Science Bangalore 560012 | Assistant Professor Department of Mathematics Indian Institute of Science Bangalore 560012 |. Lie groups and Lie algebras are one of the cornerstones of mathematics. This AIS will focus on discussing and developing the basics of topological groups, Lie groups, and Lie algebras, with both their structure and their representations in mind. The lectures aim to cover the basics of the structure theory of (complex semisimple) Lie algebras, root systems and Dynkin diagrams, topological and Lie groups, the Peter-Weyl theorem, and the correspondence between Lie algebras and Lie groups (via exponentiation). The lectures are meant for an audience of students and postdocs interested in Lie theory. IISc, Bangalore | 6 | Structure of semisimple Lie algebras: theorems of Engel and Lie (for nilpotent and solvable Lie algebras), Cartan’s criterion and the Killing form, Weyl’s theorem of complete reducibility, sl(2)-theory, toral subalgebras, root spaces.

title: IISc Lecture Notes Series
description: # IISc Lecture Notes Series. The IISc Lecture Notes Series (ILNS) of the IIScPress aims to fulfill an important need in higher education in science and engineering, particularly in India. IISc, known for its quality post-graduate education programmes, intends to makes its lecture notes available to students at large in India and abroad. These books will be authored by distinguished educators within and outside IISc. The books in this series have an appealing format for self-learning as well as for use in classroom teaching. The topics in this series encompass basic subjects that need continual upgrading in today’s fast-moving science and engineering frontiers.
